# BGET Membership Application

> Paste into Google Forms / Typeform / Tally. Keep it under 10 minutes.
> **No CV field. No certification field. No "years of experience" field — by design.**

---

### Scoring rubric (internal — do not show to applicants)

Score each 1–5. **Character is a gate.**

| Dimension | Where you see it |
|-----------|------------------|
| Character (GATE ≥4) | Q6, Q10, consistency/honesty across answers |
| Kindness | Q8, tone throughout |
| Curiosity | Q7, Q12, specificity of answers |
| Ambition | Q3, Q4 |
| Competence | Q5 |
| Humility | Q6, Q7, comfort with "I don't know" |
| Critical thinking | Q7, quality of reasoning in Q3/Q4 |
| Collaboration | Q8, Q10 |
| Responsibility | Q6, Q11 |
| Discipline | Q3 (is it ongoing?), Q5 |
| Growth mindset | Q6, Q7 |
| Positive intent | Q8, overall framing |

**Auto-decline (with a kind reply):** blank/one-word answers, copied text,
answers that only list credentials, or any Character score ≤ 2.
**Never auto-accept.** Every application gets the 15-minute conversation.
